requirement.statement: The system SHALL document and provide checkable XNL bundle examples for AI Ctrl Workflow and AI Data Workflow.

case.when: They look for AI Ctrl Workflow guidance
case.then: The docs SHALL describe the WorkCtrlFlow-backed root, runtime state boundary and embedded effects contract

case.when: They look for AI Data Workflow guidance
case.then: The docs SHALL describe the EagerDataFlow-backed DAG root, RunGraph state boundary and reuse semantics

case.given: An AI Ctrl Workflow example bundle exists
case.when: The flow-dsl checker runs on it
case.then: The checker SHALL accept the bundle without diagnostics

case.given: An AI Data Workflow example bundle exists
case.when: The flow-dsl checker runs on it
case.then: The checker SHALL accept the bundle without diagnostics
